program: Wingless external raw-input to representation to contextual prediction attribution
question: Is the useful exact-pair context signal concentrated in training-side ambiguous current motifs, rather than captured by marginal distributional aliases?
hypothesis: Reconstruct the sealed current-only and exact-pair predictors with identical sources, split, representation, and top-511 exact-pair dictionary. Using training-prefix counts only, compute each current motif's successor top1-minus-top2 probability margin. Define the ambiguity cutoff as the median margin across current motifs with at least four training transitions. Among heldout triples whose exact pair has training support >=3, exact-pair prediction will outperform current-only by at least 0.02 on the ambiguous half and by no more than 0.01 on the confident half, yielding at least a 0.02 signal-concentration gap.

prior_evidence.diagnosis: Marginal transition-distribution aliases do not capture the useful context signal. Diagnose when exact supported pair context helps before changing representation or capacity.

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host distinct from LINKDEADKB

frozen_reuse.exact_pair_predictor: byte-identical top-511 exact-pair contexts plus one overflow row

ambiguity_definition.eligible_current_row: at least four training successor observations
ambiguity_definition.row_margin: (top1 successor count - top2 successor count) / total successor count
ambiguity_definition.cutoff: median row_margin across eligible current rows, computed from training prefixes only

classification_rules.supported: All validity criteria and frozen concentration thresholds pass.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes and ambiguous supported pairs show positive exact-context gain, but the concentration gap or confident-row ceiling fails.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but exact supported pair context is not positively concentrated in ambiguous current states.
classification_rules.invalid: Any sealed-parent, authority, source, split, representation, ambiguity-cutoff, support, capacity, determinism, or heldout-isolation criterion fails.

validity_criteria: Exact sealed parent and North Star identities match.
Fresh READY_RESEARCH is bound to this exact preregistration and manifest.
All predictors and pair support are reconstructed from training prefixes only.
Ambiguity median is computed before heldout scoring and is never changed afterward.
Only diagnostic partitioning is new; no predictor or representation changes.
Full Go regression passes before probe; duplicate probes are byte-identical; all metrics are finite.
No tokenizer, parser, external model, persistent corpus, LINKDEADKB execution, production authority, or post-result tuning occurs.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter sources, split, representation, pair support threshold, ambiguity formula, median rule, predictors, metrics, thresholds, classification, or authority after primary output.

successor_if_supported.intent: use exact supported pair context only for training-side ambiguous current states while retaining current-only relation elsewhere

successor_if_mixed_or_negative.intent: test whether useful context requires longer sequence state rather than pair identity or marginal aliases
